//: The per-song config. Authored by the owner's ear with the agent's proposal as the first draft. Times in seconds on disk; every report prints m:ss. Keys starting with // are comments.
source: sections proposed from stems 2026-11-01, corrected by the owner by ear 2026-11-02
preset_note: the style dials, measured from the show's own finished sequences (effects/s ceiling, median duration, layer depth, effect mix) — never from an average of other people's files
//built_to: the build frontier: everything below it is carried over untouched on the next run

sections.name: Intro
sections.why: guitar alone; the owner: 'leave the house quiet until the band'

intent.music: one guitar, no drums, a held chord every two bars
intent.motif: one slow wash on the roofline, the sign lit, nothing else
intent.why: the song has not started; quiet is still, not narrow
intent.build: the wash widens by one group per held chord

sections.name: Verse 1
sections.why: band in on the downbeat at 0:14.8 (kick 0.91)

intent.music: kick and snare steady, bass walks, the lead sings two lines per four bars
intent.motif: kick → arches, snare → the roofline answers, the lead's face sings
intent.why: the verse introduces the instruments one by one; the house does the same
intent.build: arches alone for 8 bars, roofline joins on the second line

intent.music: the hook, cymbals open, every stem up 6 dB
intent.motif: the whole-house punch on the first beat, then the chorus pattern (bars rolling up the house) — this motif repeats and GROWS in every chorus
intent.why: the chorus is the song's identity; it must be recognisable the second time
intent.build: chorus 2 adds the matrix, chorus 3 adds the trees

approved.why: the owner, 2026-11-02: 'first 46 approved, nice work' — judged on the saved render; snapshot analysis/Example Song.v3-APPROVED-0-46.xsq

stops.why: the band stops dead before chorus 2: bass and drums at -58 dB in the stems. The house goes dark; the beds that cross it are split, not covered

casting.why: one voice, one place: the lead sings from the centre prop; the backing lines answer from the sides. Who says what comes from the script, never from pitch

designs.why: the owner, 2026-09-19: 'do not all songs feel and look the same with the same effects' — every song picks its own patterns
designs.roofline: chase, two colours, alternating direction every bar
designs.arches: single bar rolling up, one per kick
designs.power_effect: the MegaTree's spiral on the section's biggest onset

tune_to.why: the owner: 'my station is 87.9, I leave it lit the whole time minus blackouts, fade in and out at the ends'
